name: Expressive linocut
summary: A sheet of linoleum is cut with a V-gouge and printed by hand, so the cut has smooth curves and no grain. Flat opaque colour layers overlap in bold rhythmic shapes, as in the Grosvenor School prints of 1929-1938.

philosophy.core_thesis: Linoleum has no grain, so a gouge cuts a smooth curve, and flat opaque colour layers can carry rhythm and speed.
design_principles: Cut each colour on its own linoleum block with V and U gouges; the cut makes a smooth curve.
Keep each shape bold: a cut line of 1–3 mm, and a white gap of at least 1 mm.
Print the colours in opaque inks, from light to dark, with 0.5–1.5 mm of offset.
Build speed and rhythm with curved shapes that repeat across the sheet.
Print by hand with a spoon, or on a hand press, on thin Japan paper.
Number the edition under 100, and sign it in pencil.
anti_patterns: Fine hatching that needs a burin

process.matrix: Battleship linoleum on a wood block, one block for each colour
process.press: Hand-rubbed with spoon, or hand press
process.image_making: V and U gouges cut linoleum; separate blocks for colours

inks.strategy: A black key ink and three to five opaque colour inks, each from its own block, printed from light to dark.

screening.rule: Make each tone as a flat block of ink; mix a new tone by overlap of two opaque layers, with no screen.

registration.rule: Blocks are registered by hand with a frame or pins; a shift of 0.5–1.5 mm and some ink squash at the borders are part of the look.

substrate.stock: Thin Japan or mulberry paper, white to cream.
substrate.finish: Thin and smooth, with a slight fibre; it takes hand rubbing.

surface.impression: A shallow bite from hand rubbing; the flat shapes show a slight relief on the back.
surface.sheen: Matt, with a slight shine in the thick ink.
surface.texture: Smooth gouge curves, even flat colour with small voids, and no wood grain.

emotion.target_response: Fast, modern energy: the viewer sees bold curved shapes, in speed and in a crowd.

use_cases: transport and sports branding with a hand-made look
avoid_when: The image needs fine detail or a smooth tone.
The design needs exact register of small text.

modifiers.how: Change to a plank with grain and cut jagged gouge strokes; print with an uneven ink film.
Change to boxwood and a burin, cut white lines and print in one black ink.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Grosvenor School of Modern Art
